confirmed_findings.claim: The plans/v1-2-1/session-context-report/ plan appears entirely unimplemented (none of its specified handlers, routes, options, or templates exist in the diff or at HEAD) and its directory name violates RULE-PLAN-071's <date>-<slug>-<state>-<hash> convention.
confirmed_findings.fix: Confirm with the author whether the plan was deliberately deferred past 1.2.1 (then move it out of the v1-2-1 bucket) or is forgotten work; either way fix or remove the non-conformant directory so RULE-PLAN-072's glob-uniqueness contract holds.

confirmed_findings.claim: The new port-kill loop propagates a fragile pattern to PEEK_PORT and PEEK_CONTROL_PORT where kill "$pid" silently no-ops when lsof returns multiple PIDs, because embedded newlines make the quoted variable a single invalid kill argument swallowed by 2>/dev/null || true.
confirmed_findings.fix: Fix all three call sites (ADDR_PORT included) while hardening the peek multi-profile story: use kill $pid unquoted with a loop, or pipe the lsof output through xargs kill.

confirmed_findings.claim: presentationStore.saveProfileSelection's first-activation template seed is untested and relies on an implicit contract that the process cwd is the repo root for its relative templatePath to resolve.
confirmed_findings.fix: Add a t.Chdir test exercising this branch to catch a future regression if the server is ever invoked from a different cwd in a test harness or a future refactor.

confirmed_findings.claim: internal/shell.RunSync duplicates Run almost verbatim (only the timeout differs) instead of parameterizing Run with a timeout argument or option.
confirmed_findings.fix: Revisit and consolidate if a third timeout tier is ever added — three near-identical copies would be the point to consolidate.

confirmed_findings.claim: The Bash-target detection (set -- $command after excluding shell metacharacters) is a coarse heuristic that only catches an exact bare `cat <path>`, missing forms like `cat -- <path>` or `cat < path`.
